# Homework Task

- Read in global gender inequality data.
- Join the global gender inequality index to spatial data of the World, creating a new column of **difference in inequality between 2010 and 2019**.

## Plan

- Read data

  - HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv

  - World_Countries\_(Generalized)\_2173680399808997149.geojson

- Join

## Read data

- Read csv file, Select `gii_2010` \~ `gii_2019` column.
- Read geojson

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
gii <- read_csv("week4_data/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
                   col_select = c(gii_2010, gii_2019))

gii
```
